links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of custom plain-language GPT vs GPT-4 responses
links.effect: Custom GPT reduced FKGL by an average of 4.2 grade levels (95% CI 3.2, 5.1; p<0.001) and increased FRE by 17.3 points (95% CI 12.5, 21.7; p<0.001).
links.quote: The custom GPT reduced FKGL by an average of 4.2 grade levels (95 % confidence interval [CI]: 3.2, 5.1; p < 0.001) and increased FRE by an average of 17.3 points (95 % CI: 12.5, 21.7; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot patient responses relative to recommended sixth-to-eighth grade
links.effect: Preprogrammed custom GPT lowered FKGL by 4.2 grade levels and improved FRE by 17.3 points, meeting CMS readability targets without significantly compromising content quality.
links.quote: Preprogramming a custom GPT to generate plain-language instructions yields outputs that meet Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services readability targets without significantly compromising content quality.
